title: The Candle on the Table
lines: Meg has a little candle on the table.
It sits next to a bottle and an apple.
Meg picks up the bottle by the handle.
The bottle bumps the candle off the table.
The candle rolls behind a big box.
Mom tips the box up a little.
The candle rolls back to Meg.
That was a simple fix, and Meg grins.

questions.ask: What made the candle fall off the table?
questions.listenFor: The bottle bumped it when Meg lifted the handle. Send them back to that line.

questions.ask: How did Mom get the candle back?
questions.listenFor: He tipped the big box up a little. Listen for the tipping, not just 'he got it.'

questions.ask: Do you think Meg will keep the candle there? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason from the story.
